description: Free. Your FIRST verification costs nothing — call this to get the exact message to sign, then pass the signature to verify_b20_token as `freeSig`. The message is a SIWE message bound to this app, your wallet and the chain, and it expires in 5 minutes, so sign and spend it promptly. One free verification per wallet, ever.

wallet.description: The wallet that will sign, as 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

name: get_free_scan_challenge
